My bean plot is small, only 0.06 hectares, but it is important for my family's food and income. I will apply some DAP fertilizer that I received from the cooperative because it helps the beans grow stronger, and I will also spread some compost from our animals on this plot since it is near the homestead. I will plant with our own saved bean seed because improved seed is hard to find and too expensive for such a small plot, and I cannot afford chemicals or irrigation so I will weed by hand and depend on the rains. I expect my family and I to spend about twelve days working on this plot over the season, and because it is so small we do not need to hire any outside labor.
